description: This file defines the Category class within the Opencart admin event controller namespace. It contains methods to handle add, edit, and delete events for categories, adding corresponding tasks to a task management system after these events.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Controller class that manages category-related events by scheduling tasks upon add, edit, or delete operations.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new category by scheduling tasks to update category list and info.

methods.name: editCategory
methods.description: Handles editing an existing category, scheduling tasks to update category list and specific category info based on ID.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Handles deletion of a category by scheduling tasks to update category list and remove specific category info.
